name: show_rubin_finds
description: Show or hide the Rubin Observatory finds layer in Orrery: hand-picked asteroids, comets, and distant worlds the Vera C. Rubin Observatory discovered or photographed, each on its real orbit. Orrery only; if in Explore or Sky, call switch_view_mode to orrery first.

enabled.description: True to show the Rubin finds; false to hide them.
